metadata.title: Qian Cheng / Ecovacs: Father, Son, and a Farming-Civilization Robot Shop

conclusion: Zhang Xiaojun sits with Ecovacs CEO Qian Cheng — born 1990 in Shenzhen, once the youngest A-share CEO, second generation. Eleven years Shenzhen, eleven Canada, back at 22 in 2012 when the shop already sold robot vacs and his father texted teens-to-twenties of units a day. He calls it a farming civilization: plant, wait — not a nomad bite. Tesla Model S / FSD is his caution on features that do not land. Dyna is last week's fog guest, not this P&L. He will not date a clean 'I came back to take over.'
background: E155, Oct 21, 120 minutes. Father: Nanjing University, Shantou teaching, Hainan, Shenzhen SOE then trade, Suzhou factory (T1K/TED-K). Xiaojun wants the succession mix of father/son and boss/report — not a clean founder myth. Qian is David to the staff, oat-bowl, red-eye dog avatar. Tesla Model S / FSD is his caution on features that do not land; Dyna is last week's fog guest. Whisper: 钱程/科沃斯 as 前程/科物资; quotes below are the audible strings.
important_facts: Clock: 1990 Shenzhen, 11 to Canada, 08–12 university, 2012 into the company already selling robot vacs. Father's SMS: a dozen or twenty units a day, province by province. He had summer looks at the floor and no App-startup conversion in the mobile-internet boom. Succession is 'hard to say I came back in order to take over' — walk, then the chair. Youngest A-share CEO is the press line; the tape is a man who found the job an epic mis-set of 'peak life.'

Culture: farming not nomad. Plant, wait for grain; do not bite a huge category because it is huge. That is how he splits from 90s founders who own the baby. Desire had to be lit by the environment — he had enough, so he did not need to kill. Red-eye dog and oat bowl are the personal props. Internal, he still talks like an operator, not a capital-market second gen.

Compares: Tesla is the other home-robot / household machine. Dyna (E154) is research-fog, not a listed vac P&L. Diligence 603486.SH as a planted-field compounder that already had a selling robot in 2012, not as a humanoid week. The father-to-son file is the reason Xiaojun booked the hour — mix of filial and line-manager, not a clean founder myth. University was 2008–12, mobile-internet peak, and he still did not start an app shop. Canada began with ten dictionary words a day. Tesla Model S with FSD on a ten-year-old car is his caution: a feature can be sold for a decade and still not land in daily use — China robotaxi talk gets the same shrug. T1K/TED-K is the pre-listing name. Oat bowl and the red-eye dog are the personal props for wolfishness he says he lacked.

Youngest-CEO headline versus 'I did not plan the takeover.' Tesla and Dyna are two other robot files, not this P&L. Qian will not date the takeover. 2012 he walked into a company already texting teens-to-twenties of vacs a day; youngest A-share CEO was the press line, not a 20-year plan. Farming versus nomad is how he splits from 90s founders who own the baby — Wang Xinxin / JK is 'their kid, my brother.' Desire had to be lit by the room; he had enough, so he did not need to kill. Tesla Model S with FSD on a ten-year-old car is his caution that a feature can be sold and still not land. Dyna is last week's research fog, not this listed vac P&L.
mental_model.application: 603486.SH is the planted A-share. Dyna is last week's private fog. TSLA is household machines, not Ecovacs. Diligence the 2012 selling floor, not a 90s founder myth.

key_insights.view: The chair was not a 20-year plan.
key_insights.question: When did he decide to take over?
key_insights.answer: He will not date it. 2012 he walked into a company already selling vacs. Youngest CEO was the press, not the plan.

key_insights.view: Farming, not a bite of the category.
key_insights.question: How is he not Wang Xinxin?
key_insights.answer: Founders own the baby. He calls this a brother. Plant and wait.

key_insights.question: What did the father text?
key_insights.answer: Teens to twenties of units a day. That is the compounder, not a 2026 humanoid.
